name: IconButton

examples.title: Naming It
examples.code:
<IconButton icon="trash" />
// Property 'aria-label' is missing in type '{ icon: string; }' ...

examples.title: Naming It
examples.code:
<>
  <Paragraph id="archive-label" textSize="7">
    Archive this conversation
  </Paragraph>
  <IconButton icon="box-archive" aria-labelledby="archive-label" />
</>

examples.title: The Icon
examples.code:
<Buttons>
  <IconButton icon="heart" aria-label="Favorite" />
  <IconButton
    icon={<Icon name="heart" variant="regular" />}
    aria-label="Add to favorites"
  />
  <IconButton
    icon={
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="1em" height="1em" fill="currentColor">
        <path d="M18 16a3 3 0 0 0-2.4 1.2L8.9 13.7a3 3 0 0 0 0-3.4l6.7-3.5A3 3 0 1 0 15 5l-6.7 3.5a3 3 0 1 0 0 7L15 19a3 3 0 1 0 3-3Z" />
      </svg>
    }
    aria-label="Share"
  />
  <IconButton aria-label="Settings">
    <Icon name="gear" />
  </IconButton>
</Buttons>

examples.title: As a Link
examples.code:
<IconButton
  as="a"
  href="https://bulma.io/documentation/elements/button/"
  target="_blank"
  rel="noreferrer"
  icon="arrow-up-right-from-square"
  aria-label="Bulma's button docs, in a new tab"
/>

accessibility:
- **A name every time:** an icon-only button's name is its text alternative
  ([WCAG 1.1.1](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/non-text-content.html) and
  [4.1.2](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/name-role-value.html)), so the types require
  `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, and a development build warns about an empty or blank one. Name
  the action, not the picture.
- **The icon is decorative:** it renders `aria-hidden="true"`, so it adds nothing to the name. Don't
  name the `Icon` too, or the name is read twice.
- **Tooltips describe:** a [`Tooltip`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/components/tooltip) around it points the button's
  `aria-describedby` at itself, so the name and the description stay separate. Give the tooltip
  something to add, not the name again.
- **Keyboard and focus:** it's a native `<button>`, so <kbd>Enter</kbd> and <kbd>Space</kbd> press
  it, with Bulma's focus style. `isLoading` leaves it focusable.
- **Target size:** Bulma's smallest is 30 by 30 pixels, above the 24 by 24
  [WCAG 2.5.8](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum.html) asks for.
- **Toggles** are [`ToggleButton`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/elements/togglebutton), which reports `aria-pressed`. Give an
  icon-only one an `aria-label` the same way.
- **Forced colors:** a font icon, or an SVG drawn in `currentColor`, takes the system's text
  color, as a button's text does.
summary: The `IconButton` component renders a button that shows only an icon, and requires a name for it. It renders through `Button`, so it takes everything `Button` takes, and adds the icon and a name the types require: `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` in its place. Bulma keeps a button whose only child is an `.icon` square at every size, and `isRounded` makes it a circle. It has no tooltip of its own: wrap it in `Tooltip` for a description.

parts.summary: The `IconButton` component renders a button that shows only an icon, and requires a name for it. It renders through `Button`, so it takes everything `Button` takes, and adds the icon and a name the types require: `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` in its place. Bulma keeps a button whose only child is an `.icon` square at every size, and `isRounded` makes it a circle. It has no tooltip of its own: wrap it in `Tooltip` for a description.

props.name: as
props.description: Render as a `<button>`, an `<a>`, or a custom component such as a router `Link`, as on `Button`.

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph. A string is an `Icon` name, drawn from the icon library `ConfigProvider` sets. An `<Icon>` renders as given, so it can carry its own `variant` or `library`. Any other node, such as an SVG or a component from an icon package, goes inside an `Icon`, which gives it the `.icon` wrapper Bulma keeps square. It's decorative: the button's name says what it does. Give the glyph here or as `children`, not both: with both, it draws `icon` and warns in development.

props.name: children
props.description: The glyph as children, the way Mantine, MUI and Chakra take it: an `<Icon>` renders as given, and any other node, such as an SVG, goes inside an `Icon`, as with `icon`. Left out when `icon` is given, which warns in development. Text warns too, since `aria-label` replaces it as the name: a button with text is a `Button`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The button's name: what a screen reader announces and what a voice control user says to press it. Required, or `aria-labelledby` in its place, since an icon has no text to name it by. Name the action ("Delete"), not the picture ("Trash"). An empty or blank one warns in development.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element whose text names the button, in place of `aria-label`.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color variant for the button. `ghost` renders a link-like button; `text` renders a minimal text-only button.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Displays a loading spinner, with everything inside the button hidden behind it, in forced colors (Windows' contrast themes) too. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the spinner stops and stays drawn. Bulma alone hides only the label, so the rest needs bestax's CSS loaded.

props.name: isFullWidth
props.deprecationNote: Use `isFullwidth` instead — `isFullwidth` wins if both are set.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Applies active styling (visual only), with no `aria-pressed`. For a button that stays pressed, use `ToggleButton`.

extraProps.name: type
extraProps.description: On a `<button>`, `'button'`, `'submit'` or `'reset'`, and `'button'` unless you pass one of the other two, so it never submits a form by accident. With another `as`, whatever that element or component takes, passed through as given, such as an `<a>`'s MIME type.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the element `as` renders, typed from `as`.

parts.catchAll: Remaining props of the element or component selected by as (default <button>) and Bulma helper props
